description: A winter forest scene in an oil-painting style. A child in a fur-trimmed cap, brown coat and red scarf holds a coiled rope on snowy ground among birch trees. A black wolf stands at the right edge among snowy pines. A mallard duck swims on partly frozen water at lower left, and a small songbird perches on a branch at left. A wooden flute lies on a branch at upper left, and two bassoon-like woodwinds lie in the snow at right and lower centre. No text, no frame.
